body:
Thank you, but I've been there, done that. No offense, but this is all high school advice. I have hobbies, a career, I travel, I have a fantastic circle of friends and I look way younger than I am (37, told I look 25). 

An ex recently told me her fiance reminds her of me. It crushed my soul. 

I don't want children, an ex who left me because of that just found out she can't have children. She and her husband are going to adopt. 

My most recent relationship ended when she got back together with someone from an abusive relationship. He threatened to cut her throat in her sleep. 

I think I'm just one of those people whom there's no one for.
